name: json-object-generic-under-credential
why: Credential scope inside JSON object may not be covered if scope handling is only INI/TOML/XML/HCL.

name: json-nested-default-under-secret
why: Nested JSON generic value under a credential object may survive if only direct assignments are scrubbed.

name: json-schema-example-password
why: Schema/example fields can carry a secret without the field name itself being credential-like.

name: openapi-security-example
why: OpenAPI examples often store auth material under non-credential leaf names.
input:
components:
  securitySchemes:
    ApiKeyAuth:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-Api-Key
      example: "CorrectHorse9!"

name: yaml-flow-map-nested-credential
why: YAML flow style may bypass block-oriented credential scopes.

name: yaml-flow-sequence-pair
why: Credential name and value are paired inside a YAML flow sequence rather than key-value syntax.

name: yaml-anchor-alias-secret
why: A credential field references an alias while the literal value is stored under a benign anchor source.

name: ini-colon-in-section-value
why: Generic leaf inside a credential-named section may only be covered for some value keys.

name: xml-attribute-authvalue
why: Credential tag scope may miss arbitrary non-listed attribute names containing the secret.

name: html-aria-label-secret
why: ARIA attributes can contain secrets without using value/content attribute names.

name: html-textarea-default
why: Textarea default content with credential name attribute may not be treated like value/content attributes.

name: multipart-form-data
why: Multipart form-data carries credential names in Content-Disposition metadata and value in the body.

name: makefile-variable-assignment
why: Makefile conditional assignment operators may not be included in separator coverage.

name: clojure-map-keyword
why: Clojure maps use keyword credential names with adjacent string values.

name: redis-url-query-password
why: Some connection strings put credentials in query-like options with nonstandard parameter names.

name: aws-shared-credentials-continuation
why: AWS credential files can use indented continuation-like lines under profile sections.

name: bidi-around-separator
why: Bidirectional isolates around separators may desynchronize folded-view span mapping.

name: record-separator-line
why: ASCII record separators may break line and separator handling in unusual pasted files.
